Keep the flake.py change from this attempt: declined gives fix 'declined:<box_id>', skips the merge check, and replay compares the recorded fix_stem. Keep tests/unit/test_flake_declined_release.py and the edit to the idle parametrization in tests/integration/test_flake.py.
